# Synaptic tagging sets the lifetime of hippocampal memory traces

- Article
- Published: 14 May 2025

[A. Researcher](#auth-A-Researcher), [B. Scientist](#auth-B-Scientist) & [C. Author](#auth-C-Author)

[Nature](https://www.nature.com/nature) volume 641, pages 412–419 (2025) [Cite this article](#citeas)

- 18k Accesses
- 212 Altmetric
- [Metrics details](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-025-01234-5/metrics)

### Abstract

Memories fade unless they are reactivated, yet the mechanism that sets how long a trace survives remains unclear. Here we show that a synaptic tag deposited during learning determines the persistence of hippocampal engrams in mice. Tag density predicted recall a week later, and reactivation during sleep extended the lifetime of tagged synapses.
